user.title: SmartThings Find
user.description: The default method for a normal desktop PC is **Cookie header**. Rotated-cookie persistence, CSRF recovery, and keepalive still apply. **Samsung Account** is an experimental advanced option only for environments that actually expose the complete `ms-app://` callback.

account.title: Samsung Account sign-in (experimental)
account.description:
This method is not guaranteed to work on a normal desktop PC. Samsung's native-app sign-in uses a fixed `ms-app://` callback, while common browsers such as Chrome and Edge may show only `{completion_url}` without exposing the complete callback.

1. [Open the Samsung Account sign-in page]({login_url})
2. Complete Samsung sign-in and any second-factor prompt.
3. Paste a **complete `ms-app://...?state=...` address**, an error message containing that address, or a parameterized `signInComplete` address only when your environment actually exposes it.
4. If the address ends at `{completion_url}`, it contains no authorization data and cannot be used. Go back and select **Cookie header**.

Home Assistant cannot read another PC browser's session or reconstruct missing callback values. Your password and second factor are handled by Samsung. Automatic web-session renewal becomes available only after initial enrollment succeeds with a complete callback.

**Mode**
- Passive: read the cached server location (lower battery impact)
- Active: request a location update first (fresher, higher battery impact)

data.redirect_uri: Complete sign-in callback (bare signInComplete URL is insufficient)

cookie.title: Cookie header (default)
cookie.description:
1) Sign in at {stf_url}
2) DevTools (F12) → Network
3) Select `chkLogin.do`
4) Copy the complete `Cookie:` request header and paste it below.

This is the reproducible default on a normal desktop PC. Server-rotated cookies are saved privately, and CSRF recovery plus jittered keepalive remain enabled. A newly copied Cookie header is still required if Samsung fully revokes the server session.

**Mode**
- Passive: read the cached server location
- Active: request a location update first

error.callback_unavailable: The supplied signInComplete address contains no authentication result. Samsung Account enrollment cannot use this URL alone; go back and select Cookie header.
error.invalid_callback: The callback is unsupported or missing required values such as state and code. Start a new sign-in and provide the complete callback.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Start again with a new sign-in link or verify the Cookie header.
error.no_devices: No devices were found for this account.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Samsung authentication or SmartThings Find. Try again later.

init.title: SmartThings Find options
init.description:
Current authentication method: `{auth_method}`

Cookie mode allows a replacement Cookie header; leave it empty to retain the current value. Samsung Account mode can rebuild an expired web session for an existing entry whose initial enrollment succeeded with a complete callback.

Keepalive calls use slight timing jitter around the configured interval. The default is 180 seconds.

**Mode**
- Passive: read the cached server location
- Active: request a location update first

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. The Cookie header is expired or invalid.
error.no_devices: No devices were found for this account.
